summary: No result-changing defect was found in the uncommitted analytical change. The new target-only mode is internally consistent; the main remaining task is to run it and inspect the generated TeX, which is not present in the working tree.

verified_clean.item: The target-only column order matches the LaTeX header and column specification.
verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/fs_avg_performance.do:36 and MATCHING/fs_avg_performance.do:53 produce eight combinations in the order represented by the eight headers at MATCHING/fs_avg_performance.do:197-199.

verified_clean.item: The target-only replication constants exactly match the cited generated results.
verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/fs_avg_performance.do:75-80 matches the raw values at MATCHING/results/create_figures_SSHA2025_tgt.tex:6, MATCHING/results/create_figures_SSHA2025_tgt.tex:10, MATCHING/results/create_figures_SSHA2025_tgt.tex:13, MATCHING/results/create_figures_SSHA2025_tgt.tex:15, MATCHING/results/create_figures_SSHA2025_tgt.tex:18, and MATCHING/results/create_figures_SSHA2025_tgt.tex:20.

verified_clean.item: The new mode stops before writing a table if the target-only linkage statistics fail their gate.
verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/fs_avg_performance.do:156-171 adds mltgt to the checked combinations only in slidestgt mode, and MATCHING/fs_avg_performance.do:181-184 exits before the file-writing block when any checked value differs.

verified_clean.item: The FamilySearch-use indicator requested for the new mixed link exists and has the intended field-level definition.
verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/fs_avg_performance.do:116 requests fs_used1930 for fs30mltgt; MATCHING/3_append_and_clean_all_links_christian_torbenV2.do:125-126 constructs it as fs_frst_used==1 | fs_last_used==1.

verified_clean.item: Blank middle initials do not inflate either validation measure.
verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/fs_avg_performance.do:119 and MATCHING/fs_avg_performance.do:126 require both initials to be nonempty before evaluating equality.

verified_clean.item: The target-only output cannot overwrite either existing table mode.
verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/fs_avg_performance.do:188-190 assigns separate output paths for default, slides, and slidestgt modes.

verified_clean.item: Default and existing slides behavior remains isolated from the new mode.
verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/fs_avg_performance.do:44 adds fs30ml only for slides, MATCHING/fs_avg_performance.do:53 adds the new combinations only for slidestgt, and MATCHING/fs_avg_performance.do:201-210 retains distinct existing header branches.

verified_clean.item: The two untracked launcher files are generated runner wrappers rather than analytical scripts.
verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/_run_profile_names_jw.do:1-2 and MATCHING/_run_tgt_fallback_diag.do:1-2 match the wrapper template generated and parsed at replication/Run-Stata.ps1:27-38 and replication/Run-Stata.ps1:55-60.

verified_clean.item: The upstream mixed target-only link job reports successful completion.
verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/_fs_tgt_run.log:3828 reports writing link1930_1940_fs1930_mltgt1940_cleaned_noraceblock0.dta, and MATCHING/_fs_tgt_run.log:3845 records RUN-STATA-RC: 0.

review_limits: No paper draft was supplied, so manuscript claims could not be checked; claims-vs-code review was limited to the changed code and its review brief.
The external census data were not readable within the repository sandbox, and the Stata pipeline was not run independently.
MATCHING/results/fs_avg_performance_slides_tgt.tex is not present, so the new mode's runtime statistics and rendered LaTeX could not be verified.
The upstream logs were readable and report successful target-link construction, but those data-generation runs were not independently reproduced.
Review was scoped to the uncommitted working tree and necessary dependency context, not the full repository.
